model_heads.head: response_classification
current_evidence: BreastDCEDL pCR/MRI bridge as external sanity-check only
not_ready_because: BreastDCEDL bridge supports pCR/MRI only, not the full OncoTrack timeline.
No external CBC/symptom/medication-cycle response labels are mapped.
Synthetic performance may reflect simulator structure.
promotion_requirements: map at least one external cohort with response labels into canonical schema
evaluate candidate and champion under identical feature subsets
show calibrated performance and failure cases by subtype/stage

model_heads.head: response_regression
current_evidence: synthetic response-score regression with uncertainty band
shortcut audit documenting MRI percent-change dependence
not_ready_because: response score is simulator-defined and partly tied to MRI percent-change
external pCR is binary and not equivalent to the 0-100 synthetic response score
promotion_requirements: define an external ordinal/continuous response endpoint
calibrate interval coverage on external data
separate imaging-supported signal from unsupported model extrapolation

model_heads.head: toxicity_signal
current_evidence: feature audit documenting shortcut-prone legacy target
not_ready_because: legacy toxicity target is heavily determined by simulator-generated nadir CBC fields
no clinician-adjudicated toxicity labels are available
promotion_requirements: redesign toxicity target as review-priority label, not diagnosis
validate against clinician-reviewed adverse-event or triage labels
calibrate by CBC missingness and symptom-only cases

model_heads.head: genetic_biomarker_context
current_evidence: canonical schema fields for ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 and variant classification
not_ready_because: genetic features in synthetic rows are simulated context, not real genetic-test records
genetic information should not be treated as direct treatment-response proof
promotion_requirements: map real biomarker/genomic cohort fields with permitted use
separate germline, somatic, biomarker, and family-history roles
keep VUS and hereditary-risk outputs routed to counselor/clinician review

model_heads.head: tumor_marker_context
not_ready_because: no longitudinal serum tumor-marker response cohort is mapped
CA 15-3, CA 27.29, and CEA cannot stand alone as response or recurrence proof
promotion_requirements: find or obtain longitudinal tumor-marker plus imaging/outcome data
evaluate markers as weak contextual trend features only
prespecify overclaim tests and clinician-review routing

model_heads.head: treatment_sequence_context
not_ready_because: synthetic treatment combinations are simulator context
no local real-world regimen-by-cycle dataset with outcomes is available
promotion_requirements: map treatment modalities from external cohort into canonical schema
run A/B comparisons with and without treatment-sequence features
prove features improve calibration without recommending treatment
